fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/gold-creek-campground (Fee Site and Info: 'No fees are required for this site', 'No fee charged. First come/first serve'; page last updated May 22, 2026), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 16-day limit, after which you must move 5 miles away. A person must occupy the site the first night; equipment may not be left unattended more than 24 hours.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/gold-creek-campground (Reservations: 'No fees. Campsites are available on a first come/first served basis.'; Restrictions: 'Camping is limited to 16 consecutive days. After 16 days, you must move 5 miles away from your camp site'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/gold-creek-campground ('This remote campground has 4 campsites', 'Campground can accommodate RV's or trailers to 25 feet.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No garbage service (pack it out). Food storage order in effect March 1 - December 1 (bears). Horses allowed.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/gold-creek-campground (Restrooms 'Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; 'No garbage service, pack it in/pack it out.'; 'Horse/Pack animals are allowed at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Small remote Bitterroot NF (Stevensville RD) campground ~15 mi east of Stevensville via Burnt Fork Rd (CR 372 / FS 312), with trails to the Skalkaho Wildlife Preserve, Gold Creek and the Easthouse National Recreation Trail; fishing in area creeks and the North Fork Bitterroot. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated May 22, 2026) confirms free, FCFS, 4 sites, RVs/trailers to 25 ft; added 16-day limit, vault toilet, no potable water.
